claim_scope: Endomorphism rank polynomial, all symmetric images, idempotent count and precise retract subchains for standard finite odd Sugihara chains.

evidence: Homomorphisms preserve order, 0 and involution; implication excludes equal positive images at distinct source positions.
Each strictly increasing positive tail preserves fusion and implication, proving the map normal form.
Idempotence is equivalent to pointwise fixation of the image; the only allowed r-subset is the terminal r-subset.
Independent finite exhaustive checks for m,n<=4 and endomorphisms through m<=10 agree with the unrestricted proof.

earlier_scientific_evidence.correction: General hom-set cardinality is covered by Aguzzoli–Mordonini; only the finer rank-and-retract result is presented as an addition.
correctness: The earlier assessment derived normal forms from order, identity, involution and implication and checked fusion and implication conversely.
It recorded finite candidate-map enumeration and an image-fixing characterization of idempotents.
originality: The earlier assessment inspected Craig–Robinson finite-chain representations and Galatos–Raftery categorical equivalence, but did not identify Aguzzoli–Mordonini's hom-set recurrence applied explicitly to finite odd Sugihara monoids.
Negative searches in earlier relevant records were recorded, but are not proof of novelty.
value: Full finite morphism arithmetic and rank/retract classification were cited as meaningful canonical algebra invariants.

originality.context: Prior general hom-set count is explicitly credited, not claimed as new. The assessed rank-resolved, image-uniqueness and retract classification was not located in the inspected primary results.
key_prior_work: Aguzzoli and Mordonini, Theorem 5 and Proposition 2, DOI:10.1007/978-3-031-74000-8_30: general counts of homomorphisms for finite odd Sugihara monoids.
Galatos and Raftery, DOI:10.1016/j.jpaa.2012.02.006: categorical equivalence.
Craig and Robinson, arXiv:2310.12935: standard finite-chain operations and relational representation.
residual_risks: The refined formulas may be implicit in unindexed duality-based or semigroup-theoretic classifications; negative searches cannot prove absolute novelty.

evidence: Complete rank distribution of the finite endomorphism monoid and classification of all its idempotents.
Precisely distinguishes the 2^m images from the m+1 retracts of a canonical finite logical algebra.
